after_schema.name: sitemap_documents
after_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_documents (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
    row_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('robots','sitemap')),
    task_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=0),
    source_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(source_kind,task_url)
)

after_schema.name: sitemap_entries
after_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_entries (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
    row_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    observation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sitemap_documents(row_id),
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0),
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(observation_id,ordinal)
)

after_schema.name: sitemap_locations
after_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_locations (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
    row_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    observation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sitemap_documents(row_id),
    entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sitemap_entries(row_id),
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0),
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(observation_id,ordinal)
)

after_schema.name: sitemap_roots
after_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_roots (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
    row_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    observation_id TEXT REFERENCES sitemap_documents(row_id),
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=0),
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)

after_schema.name: sitemap_source_measurement_commits

CREATE TABLE sitemap_source_measurement_commits (

    document_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(document_sequence>0),
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)

after_schema.name: sitemap_source_measurements

    expected_document_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sitemap_documents(row_id),
    measurement_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sitemap_source_measurements(measurement_id),
    document_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(document_sequence>0),
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)

after_schema.name: sitemap_source_measurements
after_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE sitemap_source_measurements (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(sequence>0),
    measurement_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind='sitemap'),
    task_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=0),
    source_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    capture_config_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    initial_catalog_config_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    data TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)
